themes.disagreements: The surgical procedure of dissection (201) is a strong treatment predictor and effect modifier, whereas the pathological status (202) provides negligible signal across all roles.
themes.interpretation: Mediastinal assessment indicators, distinguishing between the act of dissection and the resulting nodal status.
themes.name: Mediastinal Assessment

themes.disagreements: Cisplatin (204) shows strong outcome prognosis and effect modification; gemcitabine (208) is primarily prognostic; G12C inhibitors (207) show only weak evidence of effect modification via R-learner.
themes.interpretation: Systemic chemotherapy agents with varying roles in outcome prognosis and treatment effect heterogeneity.
themes.name: Systemic Chemotherapy

themes.disagreements: Lisinopril (209) is a clear confounder; calcium carbonate (203) acts as both a confounder and effect modifier; denosumab (205) is primarily an effect modifier; dexamethasone (206) and MET inhibitors (210) are weak or only prognostic.
themes.interpretation: Supportive, concurrent, or targeted medications exhibiting a range of confounding and effect-modifying signals.
themes.name: Supportive and Concurrent Medications
